async def act(page):
    # Click the 'homepage.' link to return to the homepage
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='homepage.').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Navigate to the admin login page
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Check if login is required and log in if so
    username_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Username')
    if await username_field.count() > 0:
        await username_field.fill('admin')
        await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Password').fill('admin123')
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Navigate to Sales > Orders
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales/order/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Filter by status 'Canceled'
    # Use a more specific selector for the status combobox
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option('canceled')
    # Apply the filter
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort by purchase date descending
    await page.get_by_role('columnheader', name='Purchase Date').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Extract date from the first row
    first_row = page.get_by_role('rowgroup').last.get_by_role('row').first
    date_cell = first_row.get_by_role('cell').first
    date_text = await date_cell.text_content()
    return date_text
